name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 仮面ライダードライブ タイプスピード
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Kamen Rider Drive Type Speed

description.ja: 平成主人公ライダープラモデル化計画「HEISEI RIDER PROJECT Beginning」もチェッカーフラッグに向かってトップギア！第18弾には「仮面ライダードライブ タイプスピード」が登場！
description.en: The Heisei hero Rider plastic model project "HEISEI RIDER PROJECT Beginning " is heading towards the checkered flag in top gear! " Kamen Rider Drive Type Speed" appears in the 18th edition!

description.ja: ■ヘッドライトを彷彿とさせる目は、クリアパーツに「リフレクションカット」加工を施し、劇中に近い光の反射を表現。
description.en: • The eyes, which are reminiscent of headlights, are made of clear parts with a "reflection cut" treatment to create a reflection of light similar to that seen in the movie.

description.ja: ■ブレーキランプやウインカーをイメージさせる箇所にはクリアパーツを使用。各所にあしらわれたダクトのメッシュ加工やメカニカルな造形も表現。
description.en: • Clear parts are used in areas reminiscent of brake lights and turn signals. The mesh processing and mechanical shapes of the ducts decorated in various places are also expressed.

description.ja: ■特徴的なタイヤは材質を変えることで質感を追求。組み立てでは変身シークエンスを追体験できる。
description.en: • Characteristic tires pursue texture by changing materials. At Assembly, you can relive the transformation sequence.

description.ja: ■本体シルバー部をエクストラフィニッシュ加工で表現。レッド・ブラック部分は鏡面磨き加工を施し、パーツの見た目に差をつけて、より劇中の印象に近い質感を追求。
description.en: • The silver part of the main body is expressed with extra finish processing. The red and black parts have been mirror-polished to create a difference in the appearance of the parts, pursuing a texture that is closer to the impression in the movie.

description.ja: ■「ベルトさん」の表情は選択式で5種のシールが付属。
description.en: • "Belt-san"'s expression can be selected and 5 types of seals are included.

description.ja: ■特徴的な「ドア銃」や「ハンドル剣」など、豊富な武装が付属！「シフトスピード」は武器にも装填可能。
description.en: • Comes with a variety of weapons, including the distinctive "door gun " and " handle sword "! " Shift Speed" can also be loaded into weapons.
• A dedicated Figure-rise Effect pedestal is included.

accessories.ja: 接続用ジョイントパーツ×１
